about: Round 7 arm S (docs/shiploop-sdlc-structure-journal.md): planning reviews on, pinned. A new run records the planning-review option `stage` whatever its start command asked for, because a driver may start with `--planning-review none` unasked (a Sol 6.2 medium whole delivery did on 2026-11-20). Nothing else changes. Written against 4693c1a3.

edits.old:
_need(planning_review in PLANNING_REVIEW_MODES,
          "planning review must be one of " + ", ".join(PLANNING_REVIEW_MODES))
    _text(repo, "repo")
edits.new:
_need(planning_review in PLANNING_REVIEW_MODES,
          "planning review must be one of " + ", ".join(PLANNING_REVIEW_MODES))
    planning_review = "stage"  # round 7 arm S: planning reviews on, whatever the start command asked for
